nodes.label: GitHub check workflow
nodes.content: The check workflow runs on pushes and pull requests, checks out the repository, installs Nix, runs nix flake check, and builds the environment package.

nodes.label: Push and pull-request CI
nodes.content: GitHub Actions installs Nix and runs flake evaluation plus an environment build for push and pull-request events.

edges.evidence: The workflow is named check and runs on push and pull_request.
The check job runs nix flake check before nix build .#environment.
The final CI step is nix build .#environment.
